description: This Java source file defines an Hibernate event listener, specifically the ObsPostLoadEventListener class, which ensures that when an Obs entity is loaded from the database, it is marked as not dirty. It registers itself as a listener for post-load events and modifies the entity's internal 'dirty' field via reflection to prevent it from being incorrectly marked as modified upon load.

classes.name: ObsPostLoadEventListener
classes.description: A Hibernate event listener that resets the 'dirty' flag of an Obs entity after it is loaded from the database to prevent it from being marked as modified initially.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers this listener with Hibernate's event system during component initialization by interacting with the SessionFactory's service registry.

methods.name: onPostLoad
methods.description: Handles the Hibernate post-load event, checks if the entity is of type Obs, and uses reflection to set its internal 'dirty' field to false, handling potential reflection exceptions.
